paragraphs.text: 基于mimo的DSH语音汇报 · MiMo voice report plugin for DeepSeek Harness
# MiMo Voice Report
**English** · 中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that **speaks a short completion notice and a two-sentence summary** every
time a task finishes — and pops up a portrait with a speech bubble whose text types itself out in s
es — and pops up a portrait with a speech bubble whose text types itself out in step with the audio.
Powered by Xiaomi **MiMo TTS**. Ships with a 7.7-second reference clip, so the default setup already
speaks in a cloned voice (`mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone`); switch one line to use a preset voice instea
peaks in a cloned voice (`mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone`); switch one line to use a preset voice instead.
`dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis-plugin` · `mimo` · `tts` · `voice-clone`
## What it does
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- **Completion line**: `任务完成啦。` (error / aborted / blocked have their own lines).
- **Summary**: one
MiMo chat call (`mimo-v2.6-flash` by default) rewrites the last assistant message into one or two s
peakable sentences; if that call fails or is rejected, a deterministic extractive summary is used in

stead.
- **Persona-aware summaries** (v1.20.0): every voice ships a persona prompt that steers the s
ummary model's tone — the tsundere reports "hmph, it's not like I did it for you", the cool pharmaci
st keeps it clipped and precise, the ojou-sama stays refined. 16 built-in prompts; override or add y
our own per voice (including custom samples) in the settings card's **人设提示词** editor (`config.person
aPrompts[id]`, max 200 chars — describe *who* and *how they speak*; structural rules are appended by

the plugin). The emergency extractive fallback bypasses personas.
- **No duplicate openings**: the
model sometimes repeats "任务完成啦"; `dedupeAnnounce()` strips a leading completion phrase and falls bac

k to the extractive path if nothing is left.
- **Pay only when needed**: synthesis happens only for
the session you are looking at; audio is **cached per turn** (a cache hit skips even the summary cal
l), and concurrent requests for the same turn (two tabs, rapid clicks, a force retry) are merged int

o a single generation.
- **Key never reaches the browser**: the API key is read in the host process;
the page only receives mp3 bytes.

## Configure
Everything lives in this package's `cordis.patch.yml` row, and most of it can be edited at runtime i
n **Settings → Plugins → MiMo Voice Report**.
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `baseUrl` | `https://token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com/v1` | OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Token-plan key

s use `token-plan-cn`; pay-as-you-go keys use `https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1` |
| `apiKey` | `''` |

MiMo API key. Empty falls back to `MIMO_API_KEY`, then `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` refs |
| `model` |
`mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone` | `mimo-v2.5-tts` (preset voice), `mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone` (clone a cl

ip), `mimo-v2.5-tts-voicedesign` (text-designed voice; timbre drifts per call) |
| `voice` | `冰糖` |

Preset voice: `冰糖`, `茉莉`, `苏打`, `白桦`, `Mia`, `Chloe`, `Milo`, `Dean` |
| `voiceSample` | `voice-samp
le.mp3` | Reference clip for clone mode, relative to the package or absolute; mp3/wav, mono, 5–15 s

of clean speech |
| `avatar` | `avatar.webp` | Portrait for the popup (png/webp/jpeg/gif); missing/e

mpty = bubble only |
| `style` | `''` | Optional delivery instruction sent as a `role: user` message

(never spoken). Leave empty for the most faithful clone |
| `tags` | `(俏皮 稚嫩)` | Audio style tag pr

epended to the text (playful + girlish-cute). `''` disables it; tags can shift timbre |
| `callMe` |
`''` | How the whale girl addresses you, appended to the opening line (任务完成啦，主人。). CJK/Latin letter

s, digits or `·`, up to 16 chars; empty = no address |
| `customAnnounces` | `{}` | Your own lines p
er bucket — `{completed, error, aborted}` (one per line, max 20 × 40 chars each) — shuffled into the
matching built-in pool; "interrupted" shares the aborted bucket. Write the address into a line itse

lf if you want it |
| `customOnly` | `false` | `true` = a bucket with custom lines uses only yours,

none of its built-ins |
| `volume` | `1` | Playback volume 0–1 (0–100%). The settings-card slider ap
plies live while dragging; **Save** writes back here. The browser half applies it to `audio.volume`

while dragging; **Save** writes back here. The browser half applies it to `audio.volume` |
[该节后续省略]
### API key
Three ways, in resolution order:
1. **In the UI** — Settings → Plugins → *MiMo Voice Report* → paste the key → Save. It is written ba
ck to this plugin's row in your profile patch (`config.apiKey`) and takes effect immediately. **Clea

r** removes the override and falls back to the sources below.
2. `MIMO_API_KEY` environment variable

.
3. `refs` in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` — `MIMO_API_KEY`, then `MIMO_TTS_API_KEY`.
The settings card shows the active source plus a masked hint (first 3 + last 4 characters). `GET /mi
mo-voice/config` never returns the full key.
## Voice presets
The repo ships **sixteen synthetic reference clips** — all rendered by MiMo itself, no original reco

rding is bundled.
Switch between them in **Settings → Plugins → MiMo Voice Report → 音色**, or edit `v
oiceSample` in `cordis.patch.yml`:
| Preset | File | Character |

| 原版 (original) | `voice-sample.mp3` | Neutral demo take of the test line |
| 俏皮版 (playful) | `voice

-sample-playful.mp3` | Playful take of the same timbre |
| 傲娇小猫 (tsundere) | `voice-sample-tsundere.

mp3` | Bright teen voice, brisk, prickly-outside-caring-inside |
| 清冷药师 (kuudere) | `voice-sample-ku

udere.mp3` | Cool mid-low voice, calm, clipped, deadpan wit |
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy & security

- The API key lives only in the host process; it is never sent to the page or written into logs.
- A
ll routes are served by the local DSH web server and are only reachable from that origin — do not ex

pose the port to a network.
- The plugin stores no conversation content beyond one in-memory record
per session (last assistant text, end reason, timestamp), capped at 60 sessions.
